text: The bazaar awakens unchanged: no departures, no graveyard, no night’s work to weigh. The roster stands with all ten seats alive. I ask Inigo: did you see or hear anything overnight that the Herald missed?

I asked Inigo whether he saw or heard anything overnight; he did not answer. Gandalf, Ripley, Neo, Sherlock, Morpheus, and Batman all confirmed the bazaar stands unchanged. Inigo, the record shows you alone remained silent to a plain question about the night’s facts.

Inigo, you marked the bazaar’s quiet dawn with “the silence itself the first fact we must read,” yet you never answered when I asked you plainly: did you see or hear anything overnight that the Herald missed? Gandalf, Ripley, Neo, Morpheus, Batman, Sherlock, Yoda, and Elsa all confirmed the roster intact; your silence is the only unanswered line.
Inigo, you have still not answered the plain question put to you this morning: did you see or hear anything overnight that the Herald missed?
